collapseOnLoad.description:
Whether or not the form sections should be collapsed on initial load.
Only takes effect if {@link UiSdlFormFieldSet#collapsible} is true.

collapsed.description:
Whether or not the form sections should be collapsed on initial load.
Only takes effect if {@link UiSdlFormFieldSet#collapsible} is true.

collapsible.description: Whether the field set should be collapsible.

fields.description: The group of fields within this fieldSet.

hidden.description: Whether the field set is currently hidden.

infoTooltipText.description: The hint text shown in the tooltip (as an info icon).

link.description: Optional link displayed at the bottom of a form section used to trigger an action.

actionButton.description: An optional action button displayed next to a form section title, disabled by default.

title: A type which represents a grouping of fields on a {@link UiSdlForm}.
name: UiSdlFormFieldSet
